lead.headline: Rice is out again and Stroud's 23 sat on the bench — Bloodsports lead by 21.6 with three to play
lead.deck: Golden and Pickens tonight, Daniels on Monday; Los Cachanillas have no starter left to kick off. ESPN: 99% for a first win.
lead.body: Start with the bad news. Rashee Rice was inactive for a second week with the hamstring and knee and still has no return date; C.J. Stroud's three-touchdown 23.0 in London sat on your bench behind a Monday quarterback the projection preferred by 4.2; Garrett Wilson finished with 8.4. None of it is costing the week. Tuten (24.7), Likely (23.9) and Jonathan Taylor (21.1 on 21 carries) have Bloodsports up 91.1 to 69.54, and Los Cachanillas have nobody left to kick off. Matthew Golden and George Pickens play Dallas-Green Bay tonight and Jayden Daniels plays Monday — 48.2 projected between them. After Monday, Washington and Jacksonville are on bye: Stroud starts, and Tuten's slot goes to Jacobs or Gordon on Tuesday's projections.
